title: Claude Tested Over 9,000 Trading Strategies (Here's What Works)
summary: 9,000 daily-bar backtests of classic strategy families (trend, mean reversion, momentum, volume, volatility, pattern) across 30 liquid assets and 15 years, walk-forward validated through a six-filter funnel down to 524 survivors. Headline: mean reversion is the only family positive on average and is ~64% of survivors; trend works only on specific names (Apple, Nvidia). Closes with an untested 'layers' framework (base signal -> risk/sizing -> uncorrelated signals -> HMM regime switching) and a Skool community pitch.
